messages:
Alex W.: Quick thought — we should tighten postmortem follow-up ownership and handback cadence. I sketched a lightweight template below. Keen for pushback before I drop this into the handbook.

Maria P.: love this. short + deterministic is key. can you add SLAs for owners?

Alex W.: yup. thinking: owner assigned within 48h, remediation plan in 7 days, verification in 30 days. if not met, auto-escalate to oncall lead.

Jamal K.: +1 to escalation. also add a small 'recurrence signal' rule: e.g., 3 similar incidents in 30d => recurring incident review. helps catch patterns early.

Sophie L.: suggest we codify "handback" meaning: owner responsible for tracking until verification, then handback to product/platform team. otherwise people assume it's done.

Alex W.: good call. propose this timeline (draft):
```
Day 0 (incident): triage + hotfix if needed
Day 1: postmortem draft + owner assigned (48h SLA)
Day 3: remediation proposals due
Day 7: remediation plan finalized + timeline + owner sign-off
Day 14: implementation check-in
Day 30: verification + postmortem closure or re-open
```

Maria P.: can we add a weekly remediation sync for owners (15 mins) so action items don't stall? maybe automated calendar invite from incident-bot.

incident-bot: Reminder: weekly remediation sync created for open postmortem owners. Link: https://calendar.example.com/teams/eng-remediation (placeholder) :calendar:

Jamal K.: rotation idea: IC rotation stays 1 week, but remediation lead rotates monthly. IC stays focused on TTR/TTA, remediation lead owns followups post-incident. reduces context-switch for ICs.

Sophie L.: that sounds sustainable. also recommend tagging followups in our issue tracker with label "pm-followup" and linking to postmortem doc for traceability.

Alex W.: actionable items from this thread:
- Add timeline + SLAs to incident handbook (Alex)
- Add recurrence rule and detection example to ops alerts (Jamal)
- Create remediation-sync calendar + incident-bot automation (Maria)
- Define handback checklist and issue tracker label (Sophie)

Maria P.: i'll prototype the calendar automation and bot message text by EOD Friday.

Jamal K.: i'll put a quick detection query in the alerts repo and share next week.

Sophie L.: i'll draft the handback checklist and the issue-label convention.

Alex W.: thanks all. i'll update the handbook PR and link these tasks. if nobody objects, i'll run this as a 6-week pilot and report metrics (time-to-owner, percent on-time remediations, recurrence count).

Sophie L.: :thumbsup: good plan.

Maria P.: :rocket:

incident-bot: Note: handbook PR created by Alex W. https://git.example.com/redwood/handbook/pulls/42 (placeholder)

Alex W.: closing thread for now — will open follow-up sync when pilot starts.
